body:
# Text Modifier Resource Pack - Customize Your Minecraft Advancements and Death Messages

## Description:
Welcome to the Text Modifier Resource Pack for Minecraft! This pack adds unique and custom advancement names, adding a unique touch to your Minecraft adventures.

## Key Features:

Advancement Modifications: The Text Modifier Resource Pack offers a range of uniquely named advancements that provide a new set of challenges and goals for players that is influenced by modern culture and series on YouTube.

Death Messages: There are also some modified death messages. Not all of them.

## Why Choose the Text Modifier Resource Pack?

It gives a feeling of modernity and gives some cultural appropriation from the 2010s to 2020s.



## Important Information:

This resource pack specifically modifies advancements and death messages in Minecraft and does not alter any other aspects of the game, including textures. Some splash texts are altered and the End Screen is completely different, being a short conversation about you killing the dragon.
Ensure that you check for updates or compatibility with specific Minecraft versions before installing the pack.

##### To use this, install the resource pack and install it to .minecraft>resourcepacks. Then, in-game, go to languages and select "Text Modified".
